scope.assessment_question: Whether first-party official domestic routes evidenced in this case or rechecked on official publisher sites can close H3's formal-replay data/right gate.
exclusions: No product selection, product admission, allocation, holding, order, trade, return or performance conclusion.
No assertion of a user account, broker route, suitability permission or paid-data entitlement.

data_quality.source: Case-local first-party SSE raw samples plus P06 retained SSE/SSE Information/SZSE route-and-terms pages and read-only recheck of other official route pages.
data_quality.fallback_path: None. A retrospective public page or sample response cannot substitute for an authorized point-in-time delivery and rights package.
warnings: P06 retains five official route/service/website-terms HTML pages only; it is route/rights reconnaissance, not a historical data delivery, contract, entitlement or point-in-time archive.

A public endpoint, product brochure, pricing page, interface specification or successful response does not prove historical completeness, source-side available_at, revision lineage, or a right to retain/normalize/replay/derive/review data.
The assessment is limited to first-party official publishers and first-party exchange-information subsidiaries; no vendor, broker-research or other third-party source is relied on.

formal_replay_assessment.reason: No evidenced route combines a complete dual-venue historical universe/lifecycle, synchronized PIT price-NAV-IOPV and cash-event ledger, REIT/ETF/bond/convertible economic-and-terms data, source available_at/revision/raw-manifest lineage, written replay rights, and broker execution/cost/settlement evidence.
formal_replay_assessment.not_an_impossibility_claim: The record does not show that no lawful first-party package can ever be procured. It shows that no such accepted package or written entitlement is present now.

gate_matrix.missing: Dual-venue, class-wide, dated listings, delistings/terminations, renames, suspensions, status, no-trade objects, source available_at, revision and coverage reconciliation.
Decision-time synchronized market price, NAV/accumulated NAV, numeric IOPV where applicable, coupon/distribution/payment and adjustment-event reconciliation.

REIT operating/expansion facts; ETF holdings and index-methodology history; bond accrual, clean/dirty-price, yield, credit and payment events; convertible conversion/call/put/redemption/terms-change history.

Written data-owner or authorized-distributor entitlement for raw retention, normalization, formal replay, derived analysis and independent review, with effective dates, scope, audit/deletion and redistribution conditions.
Dated broker route, eligibility, quote/depth or approved no-fill proxy, fee/tax terms, partial/no-fill, settlement and transaction-time feasibility evidence.

observed_or_documented_scope: Case-local SSE samples show current ETF/REIT master-list rows and limited retrospective day-k rows for ETF, REIT, exchange bond and convertible examples.

Case-local SSE samples show a REIT NAV snapshot, REIT distribution rows, fund suspension rows, ETF PCF fields/current components/snapshot positions, ETF bulletin metadata, convertible basic terms and convertible bulletin metadata.
Exchange disclosure is a first-party document-discovery route for product, distribution, coupon, credit, term and status notices.
formal_replay_boundary: The samples are code/window/page observations, not a dual-venue historical master or a complete event/status ledger.
None establishes a source-side available_at field, a historical version/revision chain, immutable delivery manifests, coverage reconciliation or a written data-use right.
Disclosure indices cannot by themselves normalize event effective time, payment completion, credit/terms history or the associated total-return adjustment.

first_party_route_assessment.owner: Shanghai Stock Exchange Information Network Co., Ltd. (first-party SSE information-services entity)
observed_or_documented_scope: The official historical-data description identifies securities basic-information files, snapshots, trade records, daily/minute K lines and auction data; the retained case copy states daily/minute K data include ETF IOPV.

The official historical-data product document describes Level-1 snapshot fields including ETF NAV and IOPV, and the official service/document pages identify historical-data and fixed-income interface/product materials.
The official price page describes historical-data access through agreed interfaces and a separately described daily-data/local-deployment mechanic.
formal_replay_boundary: The public materials do not establish a user-specific entitlement, contract version, exact historical lookback, REIT and all fixed-income class coverage, raw-file retention, normalization, formal replay, derived-analysis or independent-review permission.
A SSE-only service cannot independently satisfy the dual-venue domestic H3 universe gate.
Market-data delivery alone does not close the REIT operating, ETF methodology/holding, bond coupon/accrual/credit or complete convertible-terms/event modules.

first_party_route_assessment.owner: Shenzhen Securities Information Co., Ltd. (SZSE wholly owned first-party entity)
observed_or_documented_scope: The official SZSE notice identifies the wholly owned entity as conducting market-data licensing and data services.
The official technical-service page identifies market-data technical-support and data-interface channels.
formal_replay_boundary: Neither public page gives a product-specific H3 historical delivery, full data dictionary, licence, retention/replay/derived-analysis/review term or entitlement evidence.
It is a procurement and rights-inquiry lead, not proof that the required package is available or licensed.

first_party_rights_sources.relevant_fact: The exchange holds rights in real-time market information and exclusive rights in market-generated base information and processed information products; commercial use and onward provision require exchange consent under the stated conditions.
first_party_rights_sources.formal_effect: Public accessibility cannot be treated as a blanket data-use, retention, replay, derived-analysis or reviewer-access licence.

first_party_rights_sources.relevant_fact: SZSE states that it holds rights in real-time information, market-generated base information and processed information products, and constrains unapproved commercial use and onward provision.
first_party_rights_sources.formal_effect: A specific SZSE or authorized-distributor agreement remains required for a retained H3 archive and its permitted uses.

first_party_rights_sources.relevant_fact: The page describes product delivery/access mechanics for historical and daily data, including agreed interfaces and a local-deployment option for a daily-data product.
first_party_rights_sources.formal_effect: Delivery mechanics are not an evidenced entitlement for the case. The public page does not state the required archival, normalization, replay, derived-analysis and independent-review terms.

first_party_rights_sources.relevant_fact: The page provides an authorization-application path for fixed-income quotation display.
first_party_rights_sources.formal_effect: A display-authorization route cannot be reclassified as a historical research/replay licence without written scope and permitted-use terms.

minimum_written_rights_package: Identify the data owner/authorized distributor, contracting entity, data product, venues/classes, historic period, delivery cadence and permitted users/reviewers.
Expressly permit retention of raw deliveries and retrieval metadata, normalized/hash-bound copies, correction/version retention, formal replay and storage of derived research/audit outputs.
Expressly permit independent internal review/audit access and state any external-review, redistribution, confidentiality, deletion, post-termination and credential-custody restrictions.

Attach the data dictionary and delivery SLA, including source as_of, original available_at/publication time, revision/version identifier, raw hash/file manifest, expected-row/page counts and historical coverage/reconciliation obligations.
State that the specified permitted use covers H3 research/replay rather than only display, terminal viewing or one-time download.
